description:
Integrate a WebView into the HelpCenterApp to display a local HTML help page and implement a JavaScript bridge for communication.

1. Modify `activity_main.xml` to replace the default TextView with a `WebView` (id: `webView`) that fills the screen.
2. In `MainActivity.kt`:
   - Initialize the WebView.
   - Enable JavaScript in the WebView settings.
   - Load the local asset: `file:///android_asset/help_center.html`
   - Create a JavaScript interface class/object with a method `submitTicket(id: String)` annotated with `@JavascriptInterface`.
   - Inject this interface into the WebView using the name `"AndroidHelp"`.

The HTML file is already provided at `app/src/main/assets/help_center.html`. When the user clicks 'Contact Support' in the HTML, it calls `AndroidHelp.submitTicket("12345")`. Your native method should simply log this ticket ID.
